scripts.dev: docker compose -p backend -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && (npm --prefix backend run start:dev & backend=$!; npm --prefix frontend run dev & frontend=$!; trap 'kill "$backend" "$frontend" 2>/dev/null || true' INT TERM EXIT; wait)
scripts.dev:prod: npm --prefix frontend run build:test-production && npm --prefix backend run build && docker compose -p read-in-peace-test-production -f compose.yaml -f compose.test-production.yaml up -d --wait && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate:test-production && (npm --prefix backend run start:test-production & backend=$!; npm --prefix frontend run preview:test-production & frontend=$!; trap 'kill "$backend" "$frontend" 2>/dev/null || true' INT TERM EXIT; wait)
scripts.env:encrypt: set -e; file=${ENV_FILE:-.env.development}; case "$file" in .env.development|.env.test-production|.env.production) ;; *) echo "Unsupported env file: $file" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; keys_file=; if [ "$file" = .env.test-production ]; then keys_file=.env.test-production.keys; fi; for package in frontend backend; do (cd "$package" && if [ -n "$keys_file" ]; then ../node_modules/.bin/dotenvx encrypt -f "$file" --env-keys-file "$keys_file"; else ../node_modules/.bin/dotenvx encrypt -f "$file"; fi); done
scripts.env:decrypt: set -e; file=${ENV_FILE:-.env.development}; case "$file" in .env.development|.env.test-production|.env.production) ;; *) echo "Unsupported env file: $file" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; keys_file=; if [ "$file" = .env.test-production ]; then keys_file=.env.test-production.keys; fi; for package in frontend backend; do (cd "$package" && if [ -n "$keys_file" ]; then ../node_modules/.bin/dotenvx decrypt -f "$file" --env-keys-file "$keys_file"; else ../node_modules/.bin/dotenvx decrypt -f "$file"; fi); done
